data.name: Glossary.TermCount
data.value:
{} 項目
(Note: In mathematical notation and LaTeX display settings in English documents, curly braces `{}` are commonly used for grouping or denoting sets of elements (e.g., `\set` commands). However, when simply translating a word like "terms" into Japanese while keeping it clean from context-specific formatting such as LaTeX symbols would just be “項目”. If you meant something else by "{0}" you'd need more information.)
